item.title: The AI safety debate is confusing. Here's our guide to the different factions
item.description: The battle over AI's promise and perils is not a clash between two opposing sides, but a debate among a range of competing voices and ideologies. Here is a guide to who's who in that debate.

item.title: eBay bans airbag sales as concerns about faulty or counterfeit parts rise
item.description: eBay became the latest online retailer to ban the sale of airbags and many of their components. Aftermarket parts can be risky if they turn out to be fake or defective.

item.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said he was extremely concerned about OpenAI 's breach of an Australian health department website that the artificial intelligence company took too long to reveal.

item.title: Understanding Jensen Huang's AI optimism and how it influences President Trump
item.description: The Nvidia CEO is a relentless AI optimist with the president's ear. Stephen Witt, author of The Thinking Machine, tells NPR's Juana Summers how their relationship could shape the future of AI.

item.title: How an 'AI freeze' could make big AI companies bigger and hurt smaller firms
item.description: Critics say a slowdown of AI development among the largest companies could consolidate the power of frontier labs, just as many others are trying to catch up.
